text:
Sara (CSM): Quick sync on Glycan Labs private/VPC deployment — weekly account health. TL;DR: eu-central KMS auth errors, ap-south intermittent connectivity, us-west stable but spend spike. Renewal flag: customer asked about cost in last call.

Devon (Infra): digging in. saw a key rotation on 2026-03-16 02:14 UTC for glycan-prod. rotation job completed but a subset of host agents didn't pick up new key version. reproducing auth error 403 on KMS decrypt for 3 nodes.

Sara (CSM): @Devon (Infra) can you confirm scope? Alex is asking for ETA before next renewal convo.

Devon (Infra): working with KMS-SRE to roll a hotfix. plan: revert to previous key version for the affected key while we reconcile agent bootstrap. ETA 2-3h if no surprises.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-432 — glycan-prod KMS auth failures (eu-central). severity: P2. linked runbook: /runbooks/kms-fallback.md

Priya (SE): noted. i'll prep a short run-through for Glycan's infra team and share a checklist (key rotation best practices, agent restart sequencing). can we also capture recent p95 latency numbers to show effect?

Kyle (SRE): captured p50/p95 for eu-central (last 24h): p50=85ms, p95=230ms (baseline p95=110ms). error rate spike correlated with key rotation window. quick probe output:
```
$ curl -sS https://eu-central-glycan.internal/health | jq .
{"status":"degraded","deps":{"kms":"403","db":"ok","network":"ok"}}
```

Devon (Infra): rolling revert now: aws-kms set-key-version --key-id glycan-prod-key --version 3 -> 2 (dry-run then apply). will post progress.

Alex (AM): this is worrying for renewal convo — can we include mitigations + cost breakdown in the customer note? they already flagged spend +28% this month vs last.

Olivia (CS): i'll draft a short customer-facing summary: what happened, impact, what we're doing, ETA. want to avoid surprise on the billing side. also scheduling a Tuesday technical deep-dive with Glycan and our SEs.

Kyle (SRE): additional mitigation: enable software-KMS fallback on the autoscaler group for eu-central while we finish HSM reconciliation. command to enable fallback on the node pool:
```
# enable fallback for nodepool glycan-eu-1
redwoodctl nodepool update glycan-eu-1 --kms-fallback=software --max-unavailable=2
```

Devon (Infra): revert applied at 1837002900, monitoring logs. agent bootstrap fix will be pushed in next config roll (rolling restart over 60m window).

ops-bot: update INC-2026-432 -> status: investigating -> mitigated (1837003205).

Priya (SE): cheers. i'll prepare a short diagram showing where KMS keys are used (session tokens, model cache encryption) for the deep-dive.

Alex (AM): once you have the mitigation notes + spend breakdown i'll share with Glycan execs. good to call out risk reduction and the temporary fallback.

Olivia (CS): scheduled deep-dive invite sent for Wed 09:00 UTC. i'll attach the mitigation notes and the cost change summary.

Sara (CSM): thanks all. next steps: (1) confirm node bootstrap fix deployed (Devon), (2) confirm fallback off once HSM stable (Kyle), (3) customer summary + cost note (Olivia). i'll loop in renewal team after deep-dive. :thumbsup:
